sql_query.query: SELECT cr.*, u.firstName AS caregiverFirstName, u.lastName AS caregiverLastName FROM _care_recipient cr LEFT JOIN _user u ON cr.primaryCaregiverId = u.id WHERE cr.id = $1 AND cr.primaryCaregiverId = $2
SELECT id, name, dosage, unit, frequency, timeOfDay, active, refillDate FROM _medication WHERE careRecipientId = $1 AND active = true ORDER BY name ASC
